visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white cat with distinctive black spots sits on a light-colored wooden floor within a brightly lit indoor room. It stares intently at the shadow of a lizard-shaped toy projected onto a plain white wall. A black robotic vacuum station is positioned against the wall on the right. (2) The camera is held by a person, creating slight handheld movement. The cat's head follows the oscillating motion of the lizard shadow. A white trash can and various black technological bases are visible on the floor, under warm, naturalistic indoor lighting. (3) A second, larger cat with patchy black and white fur enters the frame from the right side and jumps towards the wall. It reaches upwards with its front paws, standing on its hind legs to paw at the lizard-shaped shadow moving across the surface. (4) In a closer shot, the larger cat continues its pursuit, jumping repeatedly. Its claws and paws make contact with the white wall as it tries to intercept the projection. The original white cat sits in the foreground, observing the other cat's frantic efforts. (5) The camera follows the larger cat as it moves away from the wall and discovers a small, tan lizard plush toy lying on the wooden floor. It pounces on the physical object, using its paws to secure the toy while its tail twitches in excitement. (6) The scene cuts to a minimalist graphic screen with a solid pink background. Large, centered white characters display the brand name '好味小姐', with smaller English text 'LADY FLAVOR' underneath, signifying the end of the video content.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sequence opens with a high-tempo, playful electronic background track featuring a strong, bouncy percussive rhythm. A female narrator speaks with a bright, high-pitched voice and an excited, friendly tone in Traditional Chinese, setting a lighthearted comedic mood for the scene. (2) A sharp, melodic 'pop' sound effect marks a transition, coinciding with the appearance of on-screen graphics. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo with rhythmic synth stabs while the narrator's voice exhibits high pitch variability and energetic inflection as she comments on the animal's behavior. (3) Multiple low-frequency thud sounds occur in quick succession, representing the physical impact of paws hitting a hard surface. The primary speaker's vocal intensity increases as she reacts with excitement, accompanied by a faint secondary female laughter in the background. (4) Ambient room tone is minimal, masked by the dominant music and vocal layers. A brief rustling sound is audible as the feline moves across the floor. The BGM tempo remains steady, driving the rhythmic pace of the audio track throughout the interaction. (5) A final, clear 'ding' synthesizer stinger plays at the very end, serving as a signature branding sound. The music and vocals resolve simultaneously, followed by a hard cut to silence at the conclusion of the recording.
